patthana23.10:1.1: na kusalaṃ na sekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā kusalo sekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā cha.
patthana23.10:2.1: na kusalaṃ na asekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā abyākato asekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.10:3.1: na kusalaṃ na nevasekkhānāsekkhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca abyākato nevasekkhānāsekkho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā pañca. nakusalattika naparittattike kusalattika parittattikaṃ
